verification.precondition: A v2 session has two digest-bound records in one global journal.
verification.stimulus: Validate the journal and independently break its length, ordinal, genesis state, genesis seal, prior-record seal link, revision chain, splice boundary, truncation boundary, and record digest.
verification.expectedSemanticState: The intact journal starts from the derived session genesis, binds every prior record digest, and closes exactly to the persisted workspace revision state.
verification.expectedEvidenceState: The test runner reports the literal assertion: the v2 session journal closes its commit revision, length, ordinal sequence, and referenced records
verification.forbiddenMutation: No wrong-genesis, missing, truncated, spliced, reordered, discontinuous, or changed journal record may validate.

behavior: the v2 session journal closes its commit revision, length, ordinal sequence, and referenced records
